# Your pregnancy companion — secure & synced.

Track symptoms, count kicks, pack your hospital bag, and monitor blood pressure. **Core features free. AI tools coming soon.**

Start TrackingSign Up with Email [See how it works ↓](https://ourpregnancy.in/#how-it-works)

![Our Pregnancy Logo](https://ourpregnancy.in/logo.png)

Made for Indian mothers 🇮🇳

Your data is private & secure

Core features are free

Works offline via PWA

## How Our Pregnancy Works

A seamless, private journey from your first trimester to delivery day.

Step 1

### Quick Setup

Enter your due date. No account required to start tracking.

Step 2

### Track Daily

Log vitals, kick counts, and contractions right on your phone.

Step 3

### Prepare

Build your hospital bag checklist and track symptoms.

Step 4

### Sync & Share

Securely sync to the cloud or share progress with your partner.

Comprehensive Toolkit

## Everything you need,  beautifully organized.

### AI Food Safety Scanner

Not sure if that street food or local fruit is safe during pregnancy? Snap a picture and let our Gemini-powered AI verify it against Indian food safety guidelines instantly.

- Detects harmful ingredients
- Tailored for Indian cuisine

![Food Scanner UI](https://ourpregnancy.in/food_scanner_updated_1779026987896.png)

### Real-Time Partner Sync

Enjoy secure storage in the cloud. Securely link devices via WebRTC to share the journey with your partner while maintaining granular privacy controls.

Sync ModeEncrypted

Cloud StorageSecure

#### Labor Readiness Score

Predictive biometrics analyzing your HRV, RHR, and Braxton Hicks frequency.

#### FHIR R4 EHR Export

Instantly export your entire care plan and vitals to major hospital systems like Epic.

#### Ask Bloom 24/7

Get immediate answers to your pregnancy questions with our fine-tuned AI companion.

#### Vitals Tracker

Log blood pressure with preeclampsia threshold alerts.

#### Kick Counter

Count fetal movements daily from 28 weeks with auto-alerts if count is low.

#### Multiple Checklists

Prepare essentials for delivery day with our curated hospital bag lists.

#### Contraction Timer

Time contractions and get the 5-1-1 hospital rule calculated automatically.

#### Pregnancy Timeline

Track weekly changes, milestones, and what to expect along your journey.

#### Calm/Dark Mode

Soothing dark mode for tracking during those 3 AM wake-ups.

Localized Care

## Made for Indian mothers 🇮🇳

Because a pregnancy in India means navigating local foods, government schemes, and unique cultural contexts. We've got you covered.

🥗

### Indian Foods Database

Know exactly what's safe. Comprehensive coverage for dal, ragi, paneer, amla, and accurate risk flags for items like raw papaya or street food.

🏥

### Govt Scheme Guide

Don't miss out on important benefits. Clear, actionable guides for JSY, PMMVY (₹5,000 cash assistance), and JSSK (hospital delivery).

📞

### Emergency Ready

Critical helplines at your fingertips. 108 Ambulance, 112 National Emergency, and iCall psychosocial support — always one tap away.

## Core features, always free.

We believe every mother deserves access to tools that make pregnancy safer and less stressful. Tracking, vitals, tasks, and more — free, always.

Start Tracking Now
